doc: HUD part: the spyglass target card, laid by the HUD over any scene while the telescope is raised; takes no touches. Top left of the safe area, right of the spyglass button (left 84 dp; the sea HUD hides the fleet column under it): token, name, nation flag + nation · type, class; hull and sails bars; cannons, speed, distance, charge, crew; the captain (portrait, role, skills) or one line when the telescope cannot make him out. `empty` = the telescope shows no target: nothing is drawn. Fields the telescope cannot show are left out by the engine.
